{'/Producer': 'WeasyPrint 70.0', '/Title': 'RFC 10049: Roughtime: A Protocol for Rough Time Synchronization', '/Author': 'Watson Ladd, Marcus Dansarie', '/Subject': '
       This document describes Roughtime, an experimental protocol that aims
to achieve two things: secure, rough time synchronization (even for
clients without any idea of what time it is) and a format for
clients to report any inconsistencies they observe between timeservers.
This document specifies the on-wire protocol required for these goals
and discusses aspects of the ecosystem needed for it to work.
